title: Chunjiang Liu
text:
Hi, I’m Chunjiang (Leo) Liu, a Business Analyst based in San Diego. I have experience working with large-scale behavioral and product data, building dashboards, defining KPIs, and turning analysis into actionable business insights. My background combines business analytics, machine learning, and cross-functional collaboration across health tech, education, and real estate.


University of California, San Diego M.S. in Business Analytics, Rady School of Management
University of California, San Diego B.S. in Cognitive Science, specialization in Machine Learning and Neural Computation



Owaves Inc. | Business Analyst Intern | Nov 2025 – Mar 2026
Worked on KPI standardization, funnel analysis, executive dashboards, and user behavior insights for a health tech platform.
Resilience Inc. | Business Analytics Lead Intern | Jul 2024 – Jun 2025
Led an analytics team, standardized reporting processes, and supported organizational decision-making through KPI tracking and dashboards.
Zhongchi Group | Data Analyst | Nov 2020 – Sep 2022
Built data systems, monitored conversion and engagement trends, and supported business operations across multiple offices.



I’m originally from China and am currently based in San Diego, California. Over the past few years, I’ve studied and worked in analytics-related fields in the United States, building a strong interest in using data to solve real business problems. Beyond work and school, I enjoy movies, fitness, and exploring how data, technology, and human behavior connect in everyday life.
